meta.title: General Tech Services SEO Services — Case Study | Teknoppy
meta.description: How Teknoppy built an SEO and GBP strategy for generaltech.ae, a UAE ISO 17025 calibration lab, with a 185-topic pillar structure and ongoing local optimization.

paragraphs.text: General Tech Services is an EIAC & ENAS accredited ISO 17025 calibration laboratory and authorized distributor of 50+ industrial brands, operating across the UAE since 1998. Teknoppy's goal was to build an SEO and local search strategy that could cover a genuinely wide service and product range — 15 calibration disciplines plus dozens of engineering services and product categories — without pages competing against each other, while strengthening the lab's Google Business Profile presence for local, service-based search.

rows.label: Key Services
rows.value: SEO Services, Local SEO / Google Business Profile Optimization, Content Strategy

items.title: No structured content strategy
items.text: Only a handful of topics were covered, leaving most of the 15 calibration disciplines and dozens of services without dedicated content, and no plan in place to expand without risking overlap.

items.title: Incomplete Google Business Profile
items.text: Categories, service areas, and photos weren't fully built out, limiting local search visibility for a multi-service, multi-location business.

items.title: Generic service pages
items.text: Services like thermal imaging, servo motor repair, custom tool boxes, mass calibration, PAT testing, and automation were bundled into one broad "services" page rather than given dedicated coverage.

items.title: No consistent reporting
items.text: Performance wasn't tracked or delivered in a structured, recurring format, making it hard to see what was working month to month.

items.title: A 185-topic pillar content strategy (directly answers Problem 1)
items.text: A full 17-pillar, 185-topic structure covers the breadth of General Tech's actual service range, later extended with a standalone 58-topic, 6-month Product & Brand Comparison strategy (brand comparisons and product/equipment comparisons) without duplicating existing topics.

items.title: Google Business Profile built out systematically (directly answers Problem 2)
items.text: Categories, service areas, product strategy, and a photo brief were developed to strengthen local search presence for a multi-service, multi-location business.

items.title: Inner-page content across real service lines (directly answers Problem 3)
items.text: Dedicated content built for specific services including thermal imaging, servo motor repair, custom tool boxes, mass calibration, PAT testing, and automation services, rather than one generic "services" page trying to cover all of them.

items.title: Structured monthly reporting (directly answers Problem 4)
items.text: Ongoing performance is tracked and delivered in a consistent monthly SEO report format, alongside an original branded 31-page SEO roadmap and 6-month forward plan.

paragraphs.text: The engagement began with a full roadmap — a 31-page branded SEO plan and simplified 6-month forward plan — establishing scope across GBP optimization, pillar content, and inner-page builds. From there, content was built out discipline-by-discipline and service-by-service against the pillar structure, with a dedicated product/brand comparison strategy added later to extend coverage without creating overlap with existing pages.

items.q: What was the main SEO challenge for General Tech Services?
items.a: Covering a genuinely wide range of services — 15 calibration disciplines, dozens of engineering services, and 50+ product brands — with content that doesn't compete against itself in search.

items.q: How is content organized across such a wide service range?
items.a: Through a 185-topic, 17-pillar structure, later extended with a separate 58-topic product and brand comparison strategy, keeping every topic distinct.

items.q: Does this case study cover the same work as General Tech's website design case study?
items.a: No — this case study covers ongoing SEO, content, and GBP work. The website design case study for this client covers a separate, one-time structural rebuild of the site itself.

items.q: Did the project affect General Tech's existing rankings?
items.a: The pillar and comparison strategies were built specifically to avoid keyword cannibalization against General Tech's existing pages — no overlapping targets were introduced.

sections.text: Written by Sanal Edison, Digital Strategist at Teknoppy
